🏃🏻‍♂️‍➡️ [WARNING: running] July recap: my second-biggest month of the year. 277.6 → 251.4mi, EG 12,328 → 10,012ft, time 50.2 → 47.4hrs. I ran 4 almost identical weeks (63.4, 60.3, 60.4 and 60.1mi), with 93% of my time down in Z1–Z2. The last week saw a drastic reduction prescribed by [CoachClaude](/posts/20260710-coachclaude-is-coming-up-nicely/) for the coming heavy weeks!

Other notables: VO₂max jumped to 54.2 (almost an all-time high), and I've run 1,413mi, only 39.2mi behind my yearly goal of 2,500!

![June vs July, the 2,500mi goal line, and the monthly trends in distance and elevation, heart rate and VO₂max, and aerobic decoupling and efficiency.](recap-stats.webp){fig-align="center" data-lightbox-src="recap-stats-full.png"}

Highlights: my longest was [HM #87](/posts/20260712-half-marathon-87/), a 14.1mi HM in Redmond. Then I went on a trip to Pittsburgh and Cupertino: I ran [my first Pittsburgh parkrun](/posts/20260725-my-first-pittsburgh-parkrun/) in 90%+ humidity and got my fastest 5k in 2026 at 23:50! I also ran [HM #89 along the North Shore](/posts/20260726-half-marathon-89-pittsburgh-north-shore/) on Three Rivers Heritage Trail, and stumbled right into a yoga class taking over the Roberto Clemente Bridge. We also revisited [Carnegie Mellon University after 20+ years](/posts/20260726-cmu-impression-after-20-years/)! In Cupertino I ran [circles at Apple Park](/posts/20260727-running-in-circles/) and took [a 6.26mi hike at Rancho San Antonio](/posts/20260731-rancho-san-antonio-hike/), sharing the trail with a doe and her fawn!

Heavy training ahead – onward! 💪

(follow my running at [benjaminhan.net/archive/#category=running](/archive/#category=running))
